test_auth_config_defaults: test that AuthConfig defaults token_expiry_days to 7 days when jwt_secret is provided
test_auth_config_token_expiry_range: test that AuthConfig rejects token_expiry_days outside the 1 to 30 day range
test_auth_config_from_env: test that get_auth_config loads the jwt_secret from the AUTH_JWT_SECRET environment variable
test_auth_config_missing_secret_generate: test that get_auth_config generates an ephemeral secret and logs a warning when AUTH_JWT_SECRET is missing
test_AuthConfig_class: test the AuthConfig class constructor with jwt_secret and token_expiry_days parameters
